snippet.title: Donut Panic - Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A World Premiere Announcement Trailer for Donut Panic. Donut Panic is a horror/management simulator in which you run a cursed donut shop. Make and serve delicious donuts and then hide in your customisable panic room when things get too much! Donut Panic is coming to PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3910750/DONUT_PANIC

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
